en: What is JIT, and why does Husk need it?
zh: 什么是 JIT？为什么 Husk 需要它？

en: Android apps and games are compiled while they run, which needs memory that can be written and then run. iOS only allows that while a debugger is attached to the app. Turning on JIT attaches one for a moment. Without it, Husk can show your library but cannot start Android or a game.
zh: 安卓应用和游戏会在运行时编译代码，需要可写入、随后又可执行的内存。iOS 只有在调试器附加到应用时才允许这样做。开启 JIT 会短暂附加调试器；未开启时，Husk 可以显示应用库，但无法启动安卓系统或游戏。

en: Which way of turning on JIT should I use?
zh: 应该选择哪种 JIT 开启方式？

en:
• **iOS 27 or later:** Settings › JIT › Pair on this iPhone. No computer needed.
• **iOS 26:** StikJIT (built in) with a pairing file made on a computer, plus LocalDevVPN.
• **Older iOS, or Husk inside LiveContainer:** the StikDebug app.
• **Installed with TrollStore:** TrollStore, with its URL Scheme setting on.
• **Jailbroken with Dopamine:** turn on JIT for apps in the jailbreak's settings.
zh:
• **iOS 27 及以上：** 设置 › JIT › 在此 iPhone 上配对，无需电脑。
• **iOS 26：** 内置 StikJIT，配合电脑生成的配对文件和 LocalDevVPN。
• **更早的 iOS，或在 LiveContainer 中运行：** 使用 StikDebug 应用。
• **通过 TrollStore 安装：** 在 TrollStore 中开启 URL Scheme 设置后使用 TrollStore。
• **使用 Dopamine 越狱：** 在越狱设置中为应用开启 JIT。

en: StikJIT says it cannot connect, or Enable JIT fails
zh: StikJIT 提示无法连接，或开启 JIT 失败

en:
1. Make sure **LocalDevVPN** is installed and connected. The VPN icon should be in the status bar.
2. Wi-Fi must be on, even though nothing leaves your iPhone.
3. **Developer Mode** must be on (Settings › Privacy & Security › Developer Mode).
4. The first time, Husk downloads Apple's Developer Disk Image, which can take a minute. Let it finish.
5. Still failing? Toggle LocalDevVPN off and on, then pair again.
zh:
1. 确认已安装并连接 **LocalDevVPN**，状态栏应显示 VPN 图标。
2. 保持 Wi-Fi 开启，即使所有通信都留在 iPhone 本机。
3. 开启 **开发者模式**（设置 › 隐私与安全性 › 开发者模式）。
4. 首次运行时 Husk 会下载 Apple 开发者磁盘映像，请等待下载完成。
5. 仍然失败时，断开并重新连接 LocalDevVPN，然后重新配对。

en: “Pair with Husk” does not appear in Developer Mode
zh: 开发者模式中没有出现“与 Husk 配对”

en: Tap **Start pairing** in Husk first and allow **Local Network** access when asked. If you said no earlier, turn it on in Settings › Privacy & Security › Local Network › Husk. Wi-Fi has to be on. Developer Mode must already be enabled, which restarts the iPhone the first time.
zh: 先在 Husk 中点击 **开始配对**，并在提示时允许 **本地网络** 访问。如果之前拒绝过，请前往 设置 › 隐私与安全性 › 本地网络 › Husk 开启权限。Wi-Fi 和开发者模式都必须开启；首次开启开发者模式会重启 iPhone。

en: Pairing files stop working when the iPhone's trust settings are reset, and sometimes after an iOS update. Make a new one, or pair on the iPhone itself if you are on iOS 27, then import it again in Settings › JIT.
zh: 重置 iPhone 的信任设置后，配对文件会失效；iOS 更新后有时也会失效。请重新生成配对文件，或在 iOS 27 上直接用 iPhone 配对，然后在 设置 › JIT 中重新导入。

en: StikDebug opens but JIT stays off
zh: StikDebug 打开了，但 JIT 仍未开启

en: Open StikDebug on its own and check that it has your pairing file and that LocalDevVPN is connected. Update StikDebug to the latest release. Husk sends StikDebug its script itself, so nothing needs setting up for Husk inside StikDebug.
zh: 请单独打开 StikDebug，确认已导入配对文件、LocalDevVPN 已连接，并更新到最新版本。Husk 会自行把所需脚本发送给 StikDebug，无需在 StikDebug 中另行配置 Husk。

en: Why do I have to turn JIT on again?
zh: 为什么要反复开启 JIT？

en: JIT lasts as long as Husk is running. When iOS closes Husk in the background, or you swipe it away, the next launch needs JIT again. With Pair on this iPhone or a pairing file it is one tap.
zh: JIT 只在 Husk 进程运行期间有效。如果 iOS 在后台关闭 Husk，或你将其从应用切换器中划掉，下次启动就需要重新开启。有本机配对记录或配对文件时，只需点击一次。

en: Can I use Husk without JIT?
zh: 可以不使用 JIT 吗？

en: You can browse and import apps, but nothing Android can run. Every game and app needs JIT.
zh: 可以浏览和导入应用。能否免 JIT 运行取决于应用及“免 JIT 运行”功能的兼容性；完整安卓系统仍需要 JIT。

en: Husk will not open at all

• **Opens and closes instantly:** the signing certificate has probably expired. Free Apple accounts last 7 days. Re-sign or reinstall Husk with your sideloader; your apps and saves stay.
• **“Untrusted Developer”:** go to Settings › General › VPN & Device Management and trust your certificate.
• **Asks for Developer Mode:** turn it on in Settings › Privacy & Security.
zh:
• **打开后立刻退出：** 签名证书可能已过期，免费 Apple 账号签名通常有效 7 天。请使用原侧载工具重新签名或覆盖安装，以保留应用与存档。
• **提示“不受信任的开发者”：** 前往 设置 › 通用 › VPN 与设备管理，信任你的证书。
• **要求开发者模式：** 在 设置 › 隐私与安全性 中开启。

zh: 在应用库中打开应用详情页，点击 **分享报告**。Husk 自身的日志位于 设置 › 关于 › **打开控制台**；开启 **开发者信息** 后可以记录更多细节。

en: How do I add a PS4 game?
zh: 如何添加 PS4 游戏？

en: Tap + and pick a fake package (.pkg), a folder of packages, or an extracted game folder (eboot.bin and sce_sys). Husk installs it into PS4 Games in Files, and an update package goes beside the game it updates. Retail packages are locked to a PS4 and do not install. PS4 games need iOS 17.4 or later.
zh: 点击 +，选择解密的软件包（.pkg）、软件包文件夹，或已提取的游戏文件夹（包含 eboot.bin 和 sce_sys）。Husk 会将其安装到“文件”中的 PS4 游戏目录；更新包会放在对应游戏旁。零售软件包与 PS4 绑定，无法安装。PS4 游戏需要 iOS 17.4 或更高版本。

en:
Open its page in the Library. Husk says why it stopped:
• **Protected app:** it checks that it is on a real Android phone, or uses anti-cheat or DRM. Husk does not get around these.
• **Wrong kind of CPU code:** the APK only has x86 or another non-ARM architecture. Find an ARM (arm64-v8a or armeabi-v7a) version.
• **Incomplete app or missing game data:** the APK needs its split files or an OBB. Import the full .apks, .xapk or .apkm.
• **Needs Google:** the app requires a Google account or Play services Husk cannot provide.
• **Uses something Husk does not have yet:** share the report so it can be added.
zh:
在应用库中打开它的详情页，Husk 会说明停止原因：
• **受保护的应用：** 检测真实安卓手机，或使用反作弊、DRM。Husk 不会绕过这些保护。
• **处理器架构不兼容：** APK 只包含 x86 等非 ARM 代码，请获取 ARM（arm64-v8a 或 armeabi-v7a）版本。
• **应用不完整或缺少数据：** 需要分包或 OBB，请导入完整的 .apks、.xapk 或 .apkm。
• **需要 Google：** 应用依赖 Husk 无法提供的 Google 账号或 Play 服务。

zh: 此次安装在后台只能等待约 30 秒，请立即前往系统设置。
在你的 {{0}} 上输入此代码

en: A pairing file made on a computer lets Husk talk to this {{}} the same way.
zh: 在电脑上创建的配对文件同样可以让 Husk 与此 {{0}} 通信。

en: On a computer, make this {{}}'s pairing file with the [StikDebug pairing-file guide](https://github.com/StikDebug/StikDebug-Guide/blob/main/pairing_file.md).
zh: 在电脑上参照 [StikDebug 配对文件指南](https://github.com/StikDebug/StikDebug-Guide/blob/main/pairing_file.md) 创建此 {{0}} 的配对文件。

en: Save it to Files, or AirDrop it to this {{}}.
zh: 将文件保存到“文件”中，或隔空投送到此 {{0}}。

en: Tap **Choose pairing file** and pick it.
zh: 点击 **选择配对文件** 并选择该文件。

en: The pairing file stays in Husk's Documents folder and is only sent to Husk's own helper.
zh: 配对文件保存在 Husk 的“文稿”文件夹中，只会发送给 Husk 自己的助手。

en: Husk's helper reaches this {{}}'s debugging service through a local VPN. Nothing leaves your {{}}.
zh: Husk 的助手通过本地 VPN 访问此 {{0}} 的调试服务，数据不会离开你的 {{1}}。

en: Tap **Connect LocalDevVPN**. It switches the VPN on and comes straight back to Husk.
zh: 点击 **连接 LocalDevVPN**，它会开启 VPN 并立即返回 Husk。

en: Leave it connected whenever you turn JIT on.
zh: 每次开启 JIT 时，请保持 VPN 连接。

en: The first check downloads and mounts Apple's Developer Disk Image, which can take a minute.
zh: 首次检查会下载并挂载 Apple 的开发者磁盘映像，可能需要一分钟。

en: Tap **Check setup**. Husk checks LocalDevVPN and prepares the Developer Disk Image.
zh: 点击 **检查配置**，Husk 会检查 LocalDevVPN 并准备开发者磁盘映像。

en: Tap **Enable JIT**. Husk's helper attaches and Android can start.
zh: 点击 **启用 JIT**，Husk 的助手会附加，之后即可启动安卓。

en: JIT is on. Android can start.
zh: JIT 已开启，可以启动安卓。

en: StikDebug is a separate app that attaches to Husk. Husk sends it the JIT script itself, so nothing needs configuring for Husk inside StikDebug.
zh: StikDebug 是独立的调试器应用。Husk 会自动向它发送 JIT 脚本，无需在 StikDebug 内额外配置 Husk。

en: Import this {{}}'s pairing file into StikDebug.
zh: 将此 {{0}} 的配对文件导入 StikDebug。

en: Whenever Android starts, Husk opens StikDebug, which attaches and comes back.
zh: 每次启动安卓时，Husk 都会打开 StikDebug，由它附加后返回。

en: TrollStore can enable JIT for apps it installed, with no pairing file, VPN or computer.
zh: TrollStore 可以为其安装的应用开启 JIT，无需配对文件、VPN 或电脑。

en: Install Husk.ipa through TrollStore, on an iOS version TrollStore supports. It carries the entitlements TrollStore keeps, so the same file works there and in a sideloader.
zh: 请在 TrollStore 支持的 iOS 版本上，通过 TrollStore 安装 Husk.tipa。

en: In TrollStore's Settings, turn on URL Scheme. TrollStore ignores enable-jit requests without it.
zh: 在 TrollStore 设置中开启 URL Scheme，否则它会忽略启用 JIT 的请求。

en: Whenever Android or a game starts, Husk asks TrollStore to enable JIT. TrollStore opens Husk, attaches to it for a moment and lets go, which leaves it allowed to run code it wrote.
zh: 每次启动安卓或游戏时，Husk 都会请求 TrollStore 开启 JIT。TrollStore 会打开 Husk，短暂附加后断开，使其保留运行动态代码的能力。

zh: 在这台 {{0}} 上没有找到 TrollStore。它可安装在 iOS 14.0 到 17.0 上。

en: On a device jailbroken with Dopamine, JIT is a setting: the jailbreak marks every app as debugged when it opens, and a debugged app may run code it wrote. Husk needs nothing else.
zh: 在通过 Dopamine 越狱的设备上，越狱工具可在应用启动时将其标记为已调试，从而允许执行动态生成的代码，无需额外配置。

en: Open Dopamine and go to its Settings.
Turn on Allow JIT in Apps.
zh: 开启“Allow JIT in Apps”（允许应用使用 JIT）。

en: Close Husk completely and open it again. The setting applies to apps as they start.
zh: 彻底关闭 Husk 后重新打开，此设置在应用启动时生效。

zh: Husk 打开时已被标记为调试中，因此 JIT 已开启。

en: No jailbreak was found on this {{}}.
zh: 在这台 {{0}} 上没有找到越狱。

en: Pick an APK or a bundle (.xapk, .apkm, .apks), or share one to Husk from Files or Safari. Games run straight on your iPhone. Other apps run inside Android. PS4 games are extracted folders put in Husk's PS4 Games folder.
zh: 选择 APK 或应用包（.xapk、.apkm、.apks），也可以从“文件”或 Safari 分享到 Husk。游戏可直接在 iPhone 上运行，其他应用可在安卓内运行。PS4 游戏请解压后放入 Husk 的“PS4 Games”文件夹。

en: Put an extracted game folder in Husk's PS4 Games folder in Files.
zh: 请在“文件”中，将解压后的游戏文件夹放入 Husk 的“PS4 Games”文件夹。

zh: PS4 游戏需要 iOS 17.4 或更高版本。

zh: 点击 + 按钮添加游戏。

zh: 将从安卓中卸载，同时删除其数据。

en: Its files and saved progress are deleted from Husk.
zh: 将从 Husk 中删除其文件与存档。

en: Put APKs in the DeveloperTesting folder first.
zh: 请先将 APK 放入 DeveloperTesting 文件夹。

zh: 此会话已有一个测试正在运行。
没有需要重新测试的失败项目。

zh: 此会话已有一个测试正在运行。

zh: Husk 关闭但未留下记录（可能达到 iOS 内存限制，或被手动划掉）

zh: 无法导入（不是 Husk 可读取的 APK）

zh: 已导入，但未出现在游戏库中

zh: 运行中（此类应用无帧数统计）

zh: 在 Husk 的文件夹（文件 > 我的 iPhone > Husk）中新建名为 DeveloperTesting 的文件夹，并把要测试的 APK 放进去：每个应用一个 APK，或每个应用一个包含基础 APK 和拆分 APK 的文件夹。

en: Each app is played once JIT is on, watched for 15 seconds, and written down; then Husk closes. Open Husk again for the next one. At the end the results file is offered to share.
zh: 开启 JIT 后逐个运行每个应用，观察 15 秒并记录结果，然后 Husk 关闭。重新打开 Husk 运行下一个。结束后会提供结果文件供分享。

zh: 请输入私钥密码。如果没有设置密码，请留空。

zh: Husk 及其内部应用和游戏所用的语言，将在下次打开 Husk 时生效。

zh: 用于需要获取你所在国家或地区的应用。

zh: 用于显示本地时间的应用。

zh: 安卓和 PS4 游戏，就在你的 iPhone 上。

en: For the Android emulator: games fill a landscape screen, portrait apps get letterboxed.
zh: 适用于安卓模拟器：游戏填满横屏界面，竖屏应用则显示黑边。

zh: 为模拟器添加声卡。开启后无法保存运行状态，每次启动都需要冷启动。

zh: 安卓运行稳定后自动保存，使后续启动只需几秒钟。
已在此设备上完成配对。

zh: 多数游戏需要 JIT，或使用侧载证书进行无 JIT 游玩。

zh: 导入 SideStore 或 AltStore 安装 Husk 时使用的证书，或导入 .p12 文件。

en: A quick look at how Husk works: where your games are, how to add more, and where the settings live.
zh: 快速了解 Husk：游戏在哪里、如何添加，以及设置入口。

zh: 游戏按最近游玩的顺序陈列。点击游戏可选中并显示背景，再次点击或按“游玩”即可启动。⋯ 按钮提供设置等更多选项。

en: Everything you have added, by platform. Use All, Android and PS4 to filter, search by name, and long-press any game for its options. The dot shows how it runs: green plays, orange opens, red is broken.
zh: 按平台展示已添加的内容。可用“全部”“安卓”和“PS4”筛选，按名称搜索，长按游戏查看选项。圆点表示运行情况：绿色可玩、橙色可打开、红色无法运行。

en: Tap + to add an Android APK or bundle (.xapk, .apkm, .apks), or a PS4 game: a fake package (.pkg), a folder of them, or an extracted game folder. You can also share files to Husk from Files or Safari.
zh: 点击 + 添加安卓 APK、应用包（.xapk、.apkm、.apks）或 PS4 游戏：fake package（.pkg）、包含安装包的文件夹或已解压的游戏文件夹。也可以从“文件”或 Safari 分享到 Husk。

zh: 使用访客或自己的账号浏览并下载 Google Play 中的安卓应用，还可查看各应用在 Husk 中的运行情况。

zh: 游戏需要 JIT，或使用证书进行无 JIT 游玩，两者均可在设置中配置。设置还包含性能、外观、输入及可选的完整安卓模拟器。

zh: 遇到问题？“设置 › 帮助”提供常见问题解答。导致 Husk 崩溃的游戏还会留下可分享的报告。

zh: 匿名登录服务（Aurora 令牌服务）目前不可用

zh: 你的资料、游戏时长和成就，在这台 iPhone 和 itslevii.dev 上都能看到。

zh: 该文件不是 Husk 存档备份。

zh: 有存档文件过大，无法备份。

zh: 该文件不是 ZIP 压缩包。

zh: 此备份被其他应用重新压缩过；Husk 只能读取自己创建的备份。

en: A Husk account keeps your profile, playtime and achievements, here and on itslevii.dev.

Find apps in F-Droid and other repositories

zh: 应用运行时继续使用 Husk

zh: 实验功能：完整安卓模拟器
个人资料、游玩时长与成就

en: The list is written to disk, so it is on screen before Android has finished starting.
zh: 列表会保存到磁盘，因此安卓尚未启动完成时就能显示。

en: Names and icons come from Android's own launcher, which keeps the version it draws. Re-fetching throws away Husk's copies and asks again.
zh: 名称和图标来自安卓启动器。重新获取会清除 Husk 的缓存并再次请求。

en: Noto Sans CJK, the font Android uses for these languages. Games and apps that draw their own text (Unity, Flutter, cocos2d-x) show empty boxes for these characters without it. Takes effect the next time an app opens.
zh: Noto Sans CJK 是安卓使用的中日韩字体。此汉化版已内置，可供使用系统字体的应用离线读取。游戏自带字体或字形图集缺失时，仍可能需要游戏自身支持。

en: What this install was signed with. If one is Off, big games can close early: sign Husk with a method that keeps these entitlements.
zh: 这里显示此次安装的签名权限。如果某项未开启，大型游戏可能提前退出；请使用保留这些权限的方式为 Husk 签名。

en: Android draws on the real GPU through Metal — about four times the frame rate. This is the default.
zh: 安卓通过 Metal 使用真实 GPU 渲染，帧率通常明显更高，这是默认选项。

en: Every pixel is drawn by the emulated CPU. Much slower, and only worth choosing if the GPU misbehaves.
zh: 由模拟 CPU 绘制每个像素，速度慢得多，仅建议在 GPU 渲染异常时使用。

en: Adds a sound device. While it is attached Android cannot be saved — QEMU refuses to snapshot a machine with one — so every launch boots from cold. Turning it on or off costs a cold boot either way.
zh: 添加声卡后无法保存安卓状态（QEMU 不支持为带此声卡的虚拟机创建快照），因此每次都要冷启动。开启或关闭此选项都需要冷启动一次。

en: A custom resolution sets the shape itself, so this does nothing while it is on. Type a wide size for landscape.
zh: 自定义分辨率会直接决定屏幕形状，因此开启后此选项无效。需要横屏时请输入横向尺寸。

en: Android cannot reshape a screen once it is running, so a landscape game on a portrait screen gets letterboxed into a band and looks tiny. Creating it landscape is the only way it can fill it — portrait apps are letterboxed instead. Costs one cold boot.
zh: 安卓运行后无法改变屏幕形状，横屏游戏在竖屏内会缩成带黑边的狭窄区域。以横屏启动可让游戏铺满屏幕，竖屏应用则显示黑边。更改后需要冷启动一次。

en: Both sides must be between 240 and 2560.
zh: 宽和高都必须在 240 到 2560 之间。

en: The panel is built when the machine starts, so a change costs one cold boot, and the next save replaces the machine saved at the old size — changing back costs another. Sizes are rounded to a multiple of eight. Bigger is slower: every pixel is drawn by an emulated phone. Android's density does not change with the panel, so a larger one shows more rather than bigger.
zh: 屏幕在虚拟机启动时创建，因此更改后需要冷启动，下次保存会覆盖旧尺寸的状态；改回也需要再次冷启动。尺寸会取整为 8 的倍数。分辨率越高越慢，而安卓显示密度不会随屏幕改变，因此更大的尺寸会显示更多内容，而非放大内容。

en: Touch is always on. The keyboard and the rotate control are in the pill at the bottom of the guest's screen; a gamepad and a pointer are not wired through yet.
zh: 触控始终可用。键盘与旋转控制位于安卓画面底部的胶囊栏中；手柄与指针尚未接入完整安卓模拟器。

en: Saving closes apps but leaves Android's framework running, so the network still works after a restore.
zh: 保存时关闭应用，但保留安卓框架运行，以便恢复后网络仍可使用。

en: Saving stops the framework too. Clears every GPU resource, which is steadier — but the network may not come back until a cold boot.
zh: 保存时也停止安卓框架，清空全部 GPU 资源以提升稳定性，但网络可能需要冷启动后才能恢复。

en: Android reaches the internet through a virtual ethernet card on QEMU's own network. Nothing on your phone's network can see the guest, and the guest cannot see it.
zh: 安卓通过 QEMU 自身网络中的虚拟以太网卡联网。手机局域网中的设备与安卓虚拟机无法直接互访。

en: This certificate has expired. Refresh Husk in your store, then import its certificate again.
zh: 此证书已过期。请在侧载商店中刷新 Husk，然后重新导入证书。

普通内存（已调试或已越狱）

en: Husk needs memory it can write and then execute, which on iOS takes an attached debugger. There are two ways to get it: a debugger that services trap requests, or a MAP_JIT mapping, which the kernel allows any debugged process. Either one is enough — which is available depends on the device and the iOS version, so Husk tests both rather than assuming.
zh: Husk 需要可写入并执行的内存，在 iOS 上通常需要附加调试器。可通过响应陷阱请求的调试器，或内核为已调试进程允许的 MAP_JIT 映射来获得。任一方式可用即可；具体取决于设备与 iOS 版本，因此 Husk 会实际测试两种方式。

en: Turn On JIT with TrollStore at Launch
zh: 启动时用 TrollStore 开启 JIT

en: Each time Husk opens without JIT, it asks TrollStore to turn it on. TrollStore's URL Scheme setting must be on.
zh: 每次 Husk 在没有 JIT 的情况下打开时，都会请 TrollStore 开启 JIT。需要打开 TrollStore 的 URL Scheme 设置。

en: Each time Husk opens without JIT, it asks the built-in StikJIT to turn it on, so games are ready without a tap. Needs StikJIT set up once (paired) first.
zh: 每次打开 Husk 时，如果 JIT 尚未开启，会请求内置 StikJIT 自动开启，让游戏无需额外点击即可就绪。需要先完成一次 StikJIT 配对设置。

en: Needs the built-in StikJIT, which is available on iOS 26 and later.
zh: 需要内置 StikJIT，适用于 iOS 26 及以上版本。

en: Boots the guest as soon as Husk opens, when JIT is available.
zh: 有 JIT 时，Husk 一打开就启动客机系统。

en: Off by default. Husk detaches StikDebug as soon as the JIT region is held, because a debugger that iOS has suspended stops the whole app the next time it is needed. Turn this on only to collect StikDebug's own logs.
zh: 默认关闭。JIT 内存就绪后，Husk 会立即断开 StikDebug，以免 iOS 挂起调试器后导致整个应用停住。仅在需要收集 StikDebug 日志时开启。

en: APKs install from the Library's + button or from the Files tab. Split sets — a base APK plus its config pieces — must be picked together; installing the base alone fails on missing native libraries.
zh: 可通过游戏库的 + 按钮或“文件”页安装 APK。基础 APK 与配置分包必须一起选择；只安装基础包会因缺少原生库而失败。

en: Husk restores a saved machine instead of booting it, which takes seconds rather than minutes. The picture freezes while it writes. With this off, nothing saves by itself — including after an install.
zh: Husk 可直接恢复已保存的虚拟机，通常只需几秒，而非等待数分钟开机。写入时画面会冻结。关闭后不会自动保存，包括安装应用后。

en: Nothing is saved, so Android boots from cold.
zh: 没有保存的状态，安卓将冷启动。

en: Adds about 2 GB to the first download. It was captured on the software renderer, so it is not used on GPU — which cold-boots once and then saves its own.
zh: 首次下载会增加约 2 GB。该快照由软件渲染器创建，不适用于 GPU 模式；GPU 模式会先冷启动一次，再保存自己的状态。

en: Android's system, its data and the saved machine take {{}}. Apps and games on the translation layer do not need them. Android downloads again the next time it is started.
zh: 安卓系统、数据与已保存的虚拟机占用 {{0}}。转译层的应用和游戏不需要这些内容。下次启动安卓时会重新下载。

en: When a new Android image or snapshot is published, Husk asks once whether to download it. Never asked before Android has been downloaded.
zh: 发布新的安卓映像或快照后，Husk 会询问一次是否下载。尚未下载安卓时不会询问。

en: Android will boot from cold once, then save a new one.
zh: 安卓会冷启动一次，然后保存新的快照。

en: Everything installed or saved inside Android is deleted. Translation layer apps keep their data.
zh: 安卓内安装或保存的所有内容都会被删除。转译层应用会保留它们的数据。

en: Deleted the {{}} machine. The next launch boots from cold.
zh: 已删除 {{0}} 虚拟机状态，下次将冷启动。

en: No {{}} machine is saved, so nothing was deleted.
zh: 没有保存的 {{0}} 虚拟机状态，无需删除。

en: System follows the phone: light by day, dark by night. The guest's own screen stays dark either way — it is a picture of another phone. Holiday decorations appear from December to early January.
zh: “跟随系统”会随手机切换浅色与深色。安卓画面本身不受影响。节日装饰会在十二月至一月初显示。

en: Tints buttons, switches and selected states throughout the app.
zh: 为整个应用中的按钮、开关和选中状态着色。

en: Automatic follows the system appearance — light, dark and tinted. The others pin one look. iOS shows its own confirmation after a change; that alert cannot be turned off.
zh: “自动”会跟随系统的浅色、深色与着色外观，其他选项固定一种样式。更改后 iOS 会显示确认提示，此提示无法关闭。

en: Technical detail in the Android Translation Layer screens: library reports, device checks and run logs.
zh: 在安卓转译层界面中显示技术详情，包括库报告、设备检查与运行日志。

en: Husk runs unmodified Android APKs in a real Android system on your iPhone. The console shows Husk's live log, the guest's serial output and QEMU's own output — the three files any problem here is diagnosed from.
zh: Husk 可在 iPhone 上运行未经修改的安卓 APK。控制台显示 Husk 实时日志、安卓串口输出与 QEMU 输出，便于排查问题。

en: The store's certificate could not be opened. If you have a .p12, import that with the password you set when you exported it.
zh: 无法打开商店证书。如果有 .p12 文件，请导入并输入导出时设置的密码。

en: That .p12 needs a password. Enter the one you set when you exported it.
zh: 此 .p12 需要密码，请输入导出时设置的密码。

en: That password did not open the .p12. Check it, or export the certificate again.
zh: 密码无法解锁此 .p12。请检查密码，或重新导出证书。

en: This certificate belongs to team {{}}, but Husk was installed with team {{}}. Use the certificate of the Apple ID that installed Husk.
zh: 此证书属于团队 {{0}}，而 Husk 安装时使用的是团队 {{1}}。请使用安装 Husk 的 Apple ID 对应的证书。

en: The certificate could not be saved in the Keychain.
zh: 无法将证书保存到钥匙串。

en: {{}} is not installed, or did not answer.
zh: 未安装 {{0}}，或该应用没有响应。

en: The store's answer had no certificate in it.
zh: 商店的回复中没有证书。

en: How each 64-bit library maps onto the iPhone: its relocations, the instructions Husk rewrites, and anything the loader works around.
zh: 每个 64 位库如何映射到 iPhone：它的重定位、Husk 改写的指令，以及加载器绕过的问题。

en: No log yet. It is written the first time the game runs.
zh: 还没有日志。游戏第一次运行时会写入。

en: The end of the log from the last time the game started. Share it when reporting a problem.
zh: 游戏上次启动时日志的末尾。报告问题时请分享它。
每点 1 个像素，速度最快。
每点 2 个像素，默认设置。

en: Every pixel the screen has. Sharpest, and heaviest.
zh: 使用屏幕全部像素，最清晰，性能开销也最大。

en: What the game is called in Husk. The game itself is not changed.
zh: 游戏在 Husk 中显示的名称。游戏本身不会被更改。

en: {{}} Orientation and resolution apply the next time the game starts, and a game already running in this session needs Husk closed and opened again.
zh: {{0}} 屏幕方向和分辨率将在下次启动游戏时生效。如果游戏已在本次会话中运行，请关闭 Husk 后重新打开。

en: In a window, {{}} runs over Husk: move it by its title bar, resize it from the corner, and minimise it to the dock at the edge of the screen while you use the rest of Husk.
zh: {{0}} 将在 Husk 上方的窗口中运行：拖动标题栏可移动，拖动角落可缩放，还可将其最小化至屏幕边缘的程序坞，同时使用 Husk 的其他功能。

en: The game starts with nothing over it: no bar, no controller, no readout. Tap with three fingers at once to bring the bar back, and again to hide it. The Hide button in the bar does the same while playing.
zh: 游戏启动时不显示工具栏、虚拟手柄或状态信息。三指同时轻触可显示工具栏，再次轻触可隐藏。游玩时工具栏的“隐藏”按钮作用相同。

en: Geode is the mod loader for Geometry Dash. With it on, Husk downloads Geode for this version of the game, and mods are found and installed in the game itself, from Geode's button on the main menu. Applies the next time the game starts.
zh: Geode 是 Geometry Dash 的模组加载器。开启后，Husk 会下载适用于当前游戏版本的 Geode，并通过游戏主菜单中的 Geode 按钮在游戏内查找与安装模组。下次启动游戏时生效。

en: Automatic offers the controller for games that cannot be played without one (Unreal Engine games), when no real controller is connected. Always offers it for any game that understands one. A paired controller is always used.
zh: 未连接实体手柄时，“自动”仅为必须使用手柄的游戏（如 Unreal Engine 游戏）提供虚拟手柄；“始终”为所有支持手柄的游戏提供。已配对的实体手柄始终可用。

en: Puts {{}} on your Home Screen with its own icon. Tapping it opens Husk straight into the game. Husk downloads a profile: open Settings, tap Profile Downloaded, then Install.
zh: 将 {{0}} 以独立图标添加到主屏幕，点击后会直接在 Husk 中启动游戏。Husk 会下载描述文件：请打开“设置”，点击“已下载描述文件”，然后安装。

en: The game is loaded in this session. Close Husk completely and open it again to reset its data.
zh: 游戏已在本次运行中加载。请完全关闭 Husk 后重新打开，再重置它的数据。

en: Deletes what the game saved and downloaded here: saves, settings and caches. The game itself stays.
zh: 删除游戏在这里保存和下载的内容：存档、设置和缓存。游戏本身会保留。

en: Saves, settings and caches the game made here are deleted.
zh: 游戏在这里创建的存档、设置和缓存会被删除。

zh: 已绘制 {{0}} 帧 · 原生运行环境

en: Loading libraries and starting the engine
zh: 正在加载库并启动引擎

en: Tap with three fingers to show the interface
Drag a control to move it, or tap one to resize or hide it.
zh: 拖动控件可移动，点按可调整大小或隐藏。

en: Shows or hides the keyboard for the app
zh: 为应用显示或隐藏键盘

en: A Flutter app. Its engine and its compiled Dart run natively through Husk's translation layer, which loads its {{}} arm64 libraries itself.
zh: Flutter 应用。其引擎与已编译的 Dart 代码通过 Husk 转译层原生运行，并自行加载 {{0}} 个 arm64 库。

en: An Android app. Husk runs its code on its own Java runtime
zh: 安卓应用。Husk 使用自己的 Java 运行环境执行其代码

en: and loads its {{}} arm64 libraries itself.
zh: ，并自行加载 {{0}} 个 arm64 库。

en: A {{}} game. It runs through Husk's native runtime, which loads its {{}} arm64 libraries itself.
zh: {{0}} 游戏。通过 Husk 原生运行环境运行，并自行加载 {{1}} 个 arm64 库。

en: It is a landscape game: Husk turns the screen for it.
zh: 这是横屏游戏，Husk 会自动旋转屏幕。

en: Husk turns the screen the way the game asks for.
zh: Husk 会按游戏的要求旋转屏幕。

en: {{}} of them use tricks the older loader could not handle; the native runtime handles those too, except for optional anti-tamper code, which it leaves out.
zh: 其中 {{0}} 个库采用了旧加载器无法处理的方式；原生运行环境同样支持，但会跳过可选的防篡改代码。

en: Android's native code expects things of the processor and of memory that only the phone can answer -- above all, whether a library's code can run with its data writable right beside it. Enable JIT first, or the memory checks are skipped. The results go to the console too.
zh: 安卓原生代码对处理器与内存有特定要求，尤其是库代码能否在相邻数据可写的情况下执行。请先启用 JIT，否则会跳过内存检查。结果也会写入控制台。

en: The plan, in order, is docs/04-translation-layer.md in Husk's source.
zh: 计划的先后顺序见 Husk 源码中的 docs/04-translation-layer.md。

Microsoft Word, Slack, Gmail, Teams, Deezer, Flipboard and Picsart get past the crashes that stopped them. React Native's new architecture and Qt 6 start, and libGDX and other OpenGL apps draw again.
zh: Microsoft Word、Slack、Gmail、Teams、Deezer、Flipboard 和 Picsart 已解决此前阻止运行的崩溃问题。支持 React Native 新架构与 Qt 6 启动，libGDX 及其他 OpenGL 应用也可再次绘制画面。

en: Rounded buttons are proper pills, and toolbars, window backgrounds and more color formats behave as they do on a phone.
zh: 圆角按钮呈现正确的胶囊形状，工具栏、窗口背景与更多颜色格式的表现更接近真实安卓设备。

en: Fewer thread and address space crashes on sideloaded installs, and Unity games keep their frame rate up. Settings > Performance shows whether Increased Memory Limit and Extended Address Space are on.
zh: 减少侧载安装时的线程与地址空间崩溃，并改善 Unity 游戏帧率。可在“设置 › 性能”中检查“提高内存限制”和“扩展地址空间”是否开启。

en: Husk is now in Japanese too, thanks to Yuki-1018.
zh: 感谢 Yuki-1018，Husk 现已支持日语。

en: Importing a .p12, or launching with one saved, no longer crashes on iOS 27. Remove and Uninstall open next to their buttons on iPad, and Winlator's Settings no longer crashes.
zh: 修复 iOS 27 上导入 .p12 或使用已保存证书启动时的崩溃；在 iPad 上，“移除”和“卸载”提示会出现在对应按钮旁；Winlator 的设置不再导致崩溃。

LocalDevVPN is reachable and the Developer Disk Image is ready.
zh: LocalDevVPN 可连接，开发者磁盘映像已就绪。

zh: StikJIT 返回了未知的准备状态。

zh: 未提供目标进程或 Husk 的 JIT 脚本。

zh: Husk 已正常断开与内置 JIT 助手的连接。
